notes: Manifest-listed files at the resolved commit form one canonical stack; embedded JSON documents retain canonical hashes.
Output axes distinguish devotional/study guide, condensed/standard/expanded, and UI/PDF. All lengths receive full baseline study; expanded devotionals extend it under their profile contract.
Condensed index card devotionals use the engine-owned body and surface contracts, including the explicit rendered-reference range and optional brief generated prayer.
The approved condensed specimen uses Corrie ten Boom, a sixth-grade body, a primary Scripture reference, a generated prayer, and supporting references.
UI is headerless; PDF retains its document header and uses profile-aware primary Scripture expansion. Images are excluded from PDF and study guides.
The image composer owns acquisition and fallback precedence. Assembly and validation inspect delivered surfaces and return failures to the composer.
Tests verify contract wiring, paths, hashes, routing reference cases, and local fixture operations; they do not execute an LLM devotional generator.
Engine core owns memory, rolling seeds, same-day reuse, subject precedence, and rotation rules. Process supplies execution order; lint verifies the governing contracts without repeating them.

Engine body_quote_policy governs reader-accessible source material: relevant Scripture wording by default, faithful attributed source paraphrases, and primary-anchor body quotations with inline or footer attribution.

Expanded devotionals use the amended engine-owned word/paragraph bands, extended study pool, influential reference composition, and connected Scripture reasoning. Same-day expansion extends research while preserving the seed and primary anchors.
External framework dependencies are pinned in external_dependencies and loaded during initial process setup; their contents remain canonical in their source repositories.
